page_title: Gitfox - Native Git Client for Mac

sources.entry: Gitfox - Commit faster, improve your code quality with superior diffs - and look good doing it. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/gitfox/id1475511261?platform=mac)

summary.name: Gitfox
summary.one_liner: Gitfox is a native Git client for macOS for reviewing diffs, staging changes, managing branches, and resolving conflicts, built with Swift and AppKit rather than Electron.
use_cases: squashing or rewording commits with interactive rebase
resolving merge conflicts hunk by hunk
recovering lost commits from the reflog
finding the commit that introduced a bug with bisect
summary.what_it_does: Gitfox provides side-by-side diffs, including diffs for images, and lets users stage individual lines or whole hunks. It supports branch management with keyboard quick actions (⌘P), drag-and-drop for commits, branches and tags, and interactive rebase to edit, reword, drop, fix up, and squash commits. Conflicts can be resolved per hunk by keeping either side, both, or neither. It also offers Git LFS support, full-text search across commit history, bisect, reflog, snapshots, multiple committer identities, and a bundled command-line tool.
notable: Native Swift/AppKit app, explicitly not Electron
Issue tracker integration with GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Jira Cloud from the commit editor
AI commit message generation from staged changes using Claude or Codex
Integrates with external diff and merge tools such as Kaleidoscope, Meld and Beyond Compare
caveats: Free 30-day trial; paid license required afterward (pricing details not on page)
Connects to the internet for license checks, updates, crash reports and anonymous usage statistics
